alloy.preparation: 2024 T351 supplied as 25 mm thick plate; coupons 10 × 10 mm cut from plate, edges varnished leaving 100 mm² rolling plane exposed. Mechanically polished with 4000-grit SiC then 1 µm diamond paste, finally rinsed with distilled water. The paper does not restate a numerical T351 thermal/mechanical schedule.
alloy.microstructure: Rolled grain structure, 50–700 µm grains elongated along rolling direction. Coarse intermetallics up to 30 µm: spherical Al2CuMg S phase and irregular Al–Cu–Mn–Fe particles. Matrix has approximately 100 nm Al2CuMg hardening precipitates and approximately 200 nm Al20Mn3Cu2 rod dispersoids; coarse particles surrounded by dispersoid-free zones. Grain boundaries contain Al2CuMg precipitates; no precipitate-free boundary zone observed.

test_solution.preparation: Naturally aerated 1 M NaCl, reported pH 6. Solvent grade and solution-preparation recipe are not specified.

test_method.procedure_description: At unquantified room temperature, scan from −900 mV to −400 mV versus SCE at 500 mV/h; platinum counter electrode. Figure 7 second breakdown Eb2 supported by text in Sections 3.2, 3.4 and Conclusion. Separate stopped-scan potentiostatic holds and acidified pH 2 particle experiments do not define this pH 6 scan.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Second rapid increase in anodic current density near Eb2, assigned to matrix/grain-boundary dissolution with both pitting and intergranular corrosion. First Eb1 near −720 mV is selective S-phase dissolution, not the supplied matrix-pitting threshold. No fixed numerical current criterion is stated.

experiments.result_note: Approximately −620 mV: second breakdown corresponds to pitting and intergranular corrosion; first breakdown at −720 mV is S-phase dissolution, not the matrix pitting threshold. Table 1 identifies Al as base without numerical amount; no residual balance is calculated. Particle/EDS and boundary-zone chemistries are not substituted for the bulk analysis. Distilled-water rinse is surface preparation, not an explicitly stated electrolyte solvent. Room temperature remains numerically null.
